blob_h2d_gbps.note: one big copy from S2 host memory; X's M1 46.6-48.4 (47.5 nominal)

m2.loop_fragmented_34816: <= 0.5x blob and host-bound; 5-10 us of host time per chunk (0.15-0.3 s for a fragmented 32K load of 32,768 chunks; the design says ~0.3 s)
m2.batch_fragmented_34816: 0.7-0.95x blob (uncertain); >= 0.9x at 65,536 B and >= 3 MiB; host time 0.1-0.3 us per chunk
m2.sm_fragmented_34816: gather H2D >= 0.9x blob with 8-32 CTAs; scatter D2H to mapped host >= 0.8x

m3.h2d_loads: decode step median slowdown <= 5% with 0.5-2 GB H2D loads in flight (copy-engine DMA plus ~5% of DRAM bandwidth), p90 <= 15% (3b's bar: 1.1x median, 1.2x p90)
m3.d2h_stores: 154 MB D2H stores at the answer rate cost < 0.5% of decode (write-through stays default unless stores cost > 2%)

m4.bar_desktops: O_DIRECT reads of 557,056 B units 1.6-2.2 GB/s at 1 thread, 2.4-2.8 GB/s at 2, no gain past 2-3; burst writes 1.5-3 GB/s; sustained past SLC 0.5-1.5 GB/s; buffered reads slower or equal with DONTNEED; measured mixed throughput within 15% of the modelled shared lane; per-segment checkpoint iovecs (48 segments) within 10% of the unit rate; engine-loop slowdown beside 2 I/O threads < 3% (preadv releases the GIL)

decision_rules.read_2t: STOP if the 2-thread O_DIRECT read rate of 557,056 B units is < 1.75 GB/s (bar desktops)
decision_rules.mixed: STOP if the measured mixed rate is off the modelled shared-lane rate by > 15% (bar desktops)
decision_rules.copy: STOP if neither cudaMemcpyBatchAsync nor the SM gather reaches 0.8x of the blob rate on fragmented 34,816 B chunks (bar desktops)
decision_rules.stores: STOP if 154 MB stores cost > 2% of decode at the answer rate (bar desktops)

notes.worktree: the K worktree's core/ carried the lead's uncommitted step-1 edits (KS1-KS5, tiers off) during these runs; platform.host_memory and memory.copy_units were unchanged from b5b1e7f
notes.environment: desktop container (CUDA 13.0), the K worktree's own uv-synced venv (the cluster venv's editable install pointed at a removed worktree and lacked msgspec)
notes.stop: the mixed-rate STOP rule fired on the RTX 5080; the RTX 5090 was not measured (stopped and reported per the brief)
